text.zh-Hans: Mac 版 0.3.4 及更早：请到 s2arm.com 下载 dmg 覆盖安装，先不要用应用内更新——旧更新器可能更新到一半，留下新旧混装。
text.en: Mac 0.3.4 or earlier: download the dmg from s2arm.com and install it over the old app. Don't use in-app update on these versions; the old updater can stop halfway and leave a mixed install.

text.zh-Hans: Mac 版 0.3.5 到 0.3.9：现在可以直接用应用内更新升到 v0.4.0，不用再下载 dmg。之前提示「先别用应用内更新」的问题已在 v0.4.0 修好。
text.en: Mac 0.3.5 to 0.3.9: you can now update to v0.4.0 in-app — no need to download the dmg. The earlier "don't use in-app update" issue is fixed in v0.4.0.
